out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. OBSERVED BOTTLE OF WINDEX STORED ON SHELF WITH SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS AND A CONTAINER OF MAYO.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. CDI: WINDEX RELOCATED. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink in the rear of the kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC replaced the paper towels so they were near the designated handwashing sink

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw chicken and ground beef kebabs stored over vegetables and cooked RTE foods in the walk-in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. person charged and have a walk-in cooler re-organize so raw animal product were not stored over RTE products.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. PIC observed food being stored int he hallway on the ground, not being elevated 6 inches off the floor
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC agreed to move food containers so they were being stored at least six inches off the ground

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: observed containers of salt and sugar were being stored under a food prep top surface without using lids
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC agreed to acquire lids for the salt and sugar containers

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of mint leaves were being. Reused to store masala, garlic containers were being reused to store various sauces
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC agreed to stop reuse of containers

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: observed cardboard being used as shelving liners throughout the kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC agreed to discontinue use of shelving liners

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions. No test kit for quaternary ammonia available
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a @BLEACH, QUATERNARY AMMONIA, IODINE@ test kit. PIC agreed to acquire test kit, will verify compliance in 10 days

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Encrusted grease deposits and/or other soil deposits were observed on the food contact surfaces of the following cooking equipment: observed the inside of the 1 door upright cooler, 1 door upright glass display cooler were not clean to sight and touch
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. PIC agreed to clean the inside of the 1 door upright coolers Fairfax Kabob (Inspection Date: 11/19/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Observed a non clean/ un cleanable wooden board being used as a grease deflector that was attached to the greasehood
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC took down the perforated wooden board being used as a grease hood, reviewed requirements for hardwood use in the facility with EHS

violations.title: Plumbing System, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Plumbing connections under the @EQUIPMENT@ piping are leaking. Observed the handwashing sink faucet in the rear of the kitchen is leaking. PIC informed EHS that they turn the handwashing sink on/off at the wall connections
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be maintained in good repair. PIC agreed with EHS to have the handwashing sink repaired.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the @Physical structure@ in the @Location@ is in need of cleaning. Facility floors walls and cleanings, especially under and around equipment is in need of cleaning
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. PIC agreed to deep clean the facility

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink, handwashing sink next to the 3 compartment sink did not have paper towels provided
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. EHS informed PIC, PIC replaced paper towels

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: EHS observed in the walk in cooler, raw marinated chicken being stored over raw and cooked marinated lamb
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). EHS informed PIC, PIC moved the raw lamb, cooked lamb and raw chicken so the cooked lamb was being stored over the raw lamb, and the raw chicken was being stored under the raw lamb.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: EHS observed ROP Salmon being thawed inside factory sealed inside ROP packaging
violations.corrective_action: EHS informed PIC of ROP fish thawing procedure, PIC opened ROP package, informed staff of change to thawing ROP packaging. Fairfax Kabob (Inspection Date: 05/28/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window kept open for ventilation or other purposes do not have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents, hole in screen mesh barrier
violations.corrective_action: Windows or doors kept open for ventilation or other purposes shall have openings that are adequately protected against the entry of insects or rodents by 1) 16 mesh to 25.4mm (16 mesh to 1 inch) screens; 2) properly designed and installed air curtains to control flying insects; or 3) other effective means EHS informed PIC, PIC agreed to window screen in the rear of the kitchen sealed

violations.title: Food Manager Certificate & Responsibility
violations.observation: There is no Certified Food Manager present at the beginning of the inspection.
violations.corrective_action: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager. It is highly suggested that you have more than one employee with the food manager's license. ORS Interactive, Inc. (see handout provided) issues the required photo identification card with proof of successful completion of a certified food manager's exam. Failure to have a certified food manager on site during ALL hours of operation including food preparation, food service, and cleaning/sanitizing of equipment/utensils will result in closure of the establishment. CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: EHS OBSERVED CUT LETTUCE IN 3DR PREP TOP COOLER AT 55F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED CUT LETTUCE.
